test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence ((Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘LESSON’ is written as ‘IDPPNK’ and ‘CLASS’ is written as ‘ZIZPP’. How will ‘CHAPTER’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85c3bf892d20447e753331774185b49ad3cf39053964ea545b5cc1f353b3430e.png] ​

**Logic: Subtraction of '1' from the positional value of a vowel and Subtraction of '3' from the positional value of a consonant.**

‘LESSON’ is written as ‘IDPPNK’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ee13b6379a855ee9a82dc4833e727945b47b490e18d5ca6255b19f09fa94340.png] 

‘CLASS’ is written as ‘ZIZPP' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e39664c859001e1c2bbf8d787617c3818ea3ce6cd9c6f0427ea601e2a813c57.png] 

Similarly, 'CHAPTER' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5925dbbaa89ea3ff9188a28466af1d9f4a8ab7510a29f13bed100f1284e92403.png] 

Here, 'CHAPTER' is written as **'ZEZMQDO'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
